ppn1_alone.description: Victim (all-to-all, communication only) over a size sweep from 1024 to 536870912 bytes on the victim nodes, ppn 1, alone: the reference for the runs with an aggressor.

ppn1_vs_a2a.description: Victim (all-to-all, communication only) over a size sweep from 1024 to 536870912 bytes on the victim nodes, ppn 1, while a steady all-to-all of 2097152 bytes (ppn 1) runs on the aggressor nodes (it starts first and stops at the end).
